name: François Prelati
bible: A slim, playful illusionist in her early twenties with a sly half-smile, large calm violet eyes and pale porcelain skin. Short PASTEL PINK bob (bubblegum pink with rose shadows) with a fringe swept across the brow, the ends curling under at the jaw, and a stray curl on top. A CRIMSON high-collared academy coat in blood-red velvet, cropped at the waist in front and falling into a long flared hem behind, lined in dark maroon, with tarnished gold braid and a gold star clasp at the chest. Under it a WHITE ruffled blouse with a crimson bow at the throat. Plum-black pleated skirt, dark stockings and black knee-high boots with gold buckles. Gold filigree cuffs at both wrists and small glowing violet sigils on both palms. WEAPON: a slender ivory staff, a little taller than her head, with gold bands, held low in the RIGHT hand; the left hand joins it for heavy strikes. Its crown is a four-point star crystal of deep violet glass in a gold claw, with a bright pale-violet core. Magic and trails are VIOLET STARLIGHT with pink-white sparkles; the charged orb is a deep violet sphere with tiny stars inside.
design:
- top row: full-body neutral stance facing right with the staff held low in the right hand; a combat stance with the staff raised; a walking pose with the crimson coat hem swaying; a running pose; a jump with the coat flaring; a close-up of the staff's star crystal crown
- middle rows: six casting poses: violet bolts launched from the crystal crown, a two-handed overhead swing releasing a violet crescent, a charged violet orb held in the staff head, a downward plunge with the staff tip toward the ground, an aerial sweep scattering violet star shards
- bottom row: guard with the staff across the body, a hit reaction, knocked down, a victory pose holding the staff upright, the Starfall pose with three falling stars above

atk-a.title: Basic combo strikes 1 and 2 (4 frames each)
frames: combo cast 1, anticipation: the staff pulled back beside the hip, its crystal crown starting to glow violet
combo cast 1, strike: a sharp forward thrust of the staff releasing a violet arcane bolt with a pink spark trail, with a motion smear of the swing, kept inside this cell

combo cast 1, follow-through: the same blow carried on past full extension, the weapon at the very end of its path and the body still committed to it, the trail thinning out behind it (kept inside this cell)
combo cast 1, recovery: the staff returning to a ready position, the glow and sparks fading
combo cast 2, anticipation: the staff raised high overhead in both hands, the star crown flaring with light
combo cast 2, strike: a sharp downward sweep of the staff flinging a crescent of violet starlight forward and down, a bright trail, with a motion smear of the swing, kept inside this cell

combo cast 2, follow-through: the same blow carried on past full extension, the weapon at the very end of its path and the body still committed to it, the trail thinning out behind it (kept inside this cell)
combo cast 2, recovery: the staff planted low after the swing, the coat settling, sparks drifting down

aerial attack, anticipation: in mid-air, the staff raised overhead, the crystal crown shining

alt-c.title: Second stance: heavy attack (4 frames), the stance change (2 frames), and the stance idle (2 frames)
frames: stance heavy attack, charge: the magic circle grows huge behind her and the demon arm rears back
stance heavy attack, strike: slams its open claw forward in a crushing palm strike, magenta shockwave, kept inside this cell
stance heavy attack, follow-through: the blow carried through, the trail and energy dissipating (kept inside this cell)
stance heavy attack, recovery: returning to the stance-weapon ready pose
stance change 1: she snaps her fingers and a crimson magic circle opens beside her shoulder (the start of the motion)
stance change 2: the armoured violet demon unfolds out of the circle, its orange eyes igniting, its plated claw flexing (the end of the motion)
stance idle 1: standing with a mischievous smile, the staff in her left hand, the plated violet demon coiled beside and above her, its orange eyes glowing, its segmented tail curling
stance idle 2: the same stance idle breathing in, a slight rise of the shoulders, hair and cloth drifting

sheetNotes.art: Starfall (Lumi's Rift Art), six frames: 1-2 she raises the staff high over her head, violet light gathering in the crystal crown and pink sparkles rising; 3-4 three falling violet star shards streak diagonally down toward the right edge of the cell and burst into starlight where they land, everything kept inside the cell; 5-6 the staff lowered, the sparkles fading and the coat settling. Only stars, sparkles and sigils, no letters or symbols.
sheetNotes.idle: the crimson coat hem and the bob's stray curl drift with each breath; the staff stays in the right hand with its crown upright.
sheetNotes.run: the long coat hem swings out behind on each stride; the staff is carried upright at the side in the right hand, never dragging.
sheetNotes.misc: Taunt: she twirls the staff once, then tips her chin up with a sly smile and a wink. Victory: she plants the staff upright beside her, one hand resting on its crown, a small violet star-burst orbiting her, a playful pose.
sheetNotes.ko: Intro: she walks in with the staff trailing low, lifts it to shoulder height, spins it in a bright flourish that leaves a trail of violet sparks, then settles into stance with the crown raised and a confident smile.
sheetNotes.skill: Phantom Stars, her own special (three falling-star bolts that slow whatever they touch). She holds the ivory staff in the RIGHT hand, the violet star crystal glowing. 1: she raises the staff overhead, the crystal brightening. 2: the staff pointed up, three violet stars gathering in a ring above her head. 3: she swings the staff down in front and the three star bolts launch forward. 4: three violet-pink falling stars streaking forward at full force, each with a sparkle trail. 5: the star trails fading into pink-white sparkles, the staff lowering. 6: back to a ready stance with the staff held low.
sheetNotes.alt-a: THIS SHEET SHOWS HIS/HER SECOND FIGHTING STANCE. In EVERY frame the weapon is a SUMMONED DEMON: a towering armoured demon of violet-grey plated segments (a long jointed arm ending in a huge plated claw with five long talons, a long segmented tail like a spine, spiked plates, two GLOWING ORANGE EYES in a narrow plated head) that reaches out of a glowing crimson-magenta magic circle hovering beside her - NOT the usual weapon from the reference images (the costume, face, hair and colours stay exactly as the reference). How it is held: the staff in her left hand, the demon arm emerging from a magic circle at her right shoulder and striking IN FRONT of her (she barely moves; the demon arm does the hitting).
